The report does not define the observable 'unexplained failures' beyond the qualitative statement, so V is encoded as a grounded Boolean occurrence tied to the disjoint-bits matching condition.

limitations: The 'only when' exclusivity of the zero-cost guard is only partially represented; the converse (guard triggers only if one side receives without sending) is not encoded.
